label: Invalid bundle rejected with an OperationOutcome
description: The service refuses the bundle as not valid and answers HTTP 400 with an OperationOutcome that names the element at fault, which PAS 2.0.1 allows in place of a bundle. The CRD sentinel P32H-BAD400 selects it too.
basis: Synthetic. An OperationOutcome, which PAS 2.0.1 lets the $submit and $inquire operations return in place of a bundle (input/fsh/ClaimOperation.fsh of the guide's 2.0.1 source). Its wording and the element it names are this project's. It has not been observed from the live service.

details.text: The bundle is not a valid prior authorization request.

issue.diagnostics: Claim.insurance: at least one is required, and none was found.
